## Signature

`interface GetStatusResult`

## Fields

| Field                    | Type                               | Required | Description                                                                                                     |
| ------------------------ | ---------------------------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `artifactStatuses`       | `ArtifactStatusEntry[]`            | yes      | Effective status for each artifact attached to the change.                                                      |
| `blockers`               | `readonly Blocker[]`               | yes      | High-visibility blockers preventing progress.                                                                   |
| `change`                 | `Change`                           | no       | The loaded active change; absent when only a draft exists.                                                      |
| `draftView`              | `DraftedChangeView`                | no       | The drafted read model; absent for active changes.                                                              |
| `implementationTracking` | `ImplementationTrackingProjection` | yes      | Raw implementation-tracking projection.                                                                         |
| `lifecycle`              | `LifecycleContext`                 | yes      | Pre-computed lifecycle context.                                                                                 |
| `nextAction`             | `NextAction`                       | yes      | Recommended next action.                                                                                        |
| `review`                 | `ReviewSummary`                    | yes      | Whether validated artifacts require review before continuing.                                                   |
| `specDependsOn`          | `Record<string, string[]>`         | yes      | Per-spec declared dependencies from the change manifest.                                                        |
| `unchanged`              | `boolean`                          | no       | When `true`, the client revision matched or exceeded `change.updatedAt` and full status evaluation was skipped. |

catalog.title: ListOptions
catalog.description: Shared pagination options for listable repository ports. Host-controlled pagination — ports apply **no default limit** when `limit` is omitted. - Omitted `limit` and `after` → return the full sorted set; `meta.limit === meta.total` (empty lists → `meta.limit === 0`). - `after` without `limit` → return the remainder strictly after the cursor; `meta.limit` equals the returned count. - `limit` set → page or keyset window of at most `limit` items; `meta.limit === limit`. - `page` requires an explicit `limit`; `page` and `after` are mutually exclusive. - `page` is 1-based when used with `limit`. - `after` continues strictly after the cursor position in canonical sort order.
catalog.content:
# ListOptions

Shared pagination options for listable repository ports.

Host-controlled pagination — ports apply **no default limit** when `limit` is omitted.

- Omitted `limit` and `after` → return the full sorted set; `meta.limit === meta.total`
  (empty lists → `meta.limit === 0`).
- `after` without `limit` → return the remainder strictly after the cursor; `meta.limit`
  equals the returned count.
- `limit` set → page or keyset window of at most `limit` items; `meta.limit === limit`.
- `page` requires an explicit `limit`; `page` and `after` are mutually exclusive.
- `page` is 1-based when used with `limit`.
- `after` continues strictly after the cursor position in canonical sort order.

Import: `import type { ListOptions } from '@specd/sdk'`

catalog.title: MetadataExtraction
catalog.description: Top-level schema declaration for deterministic metadata extraction. Each field maps a metadata key to one or more extractor entries that declare how to pull that field's value from artifact ASTs. Single-value fields (title, description) use a single entry; array-value fields (rules, scenarios, context) use an array of entries.
catalog.content:
# MetadataExtraction

Top-level schema declaration for deterministic metadata extraction.

Each field maps a metadata key to one or more extractor entries that
declare how to pull that field's value from artifact ASTs. Single-value
fields (title, description) use a single entry; array-value fields
(rules, scenarios, context) use an array of entries.

Import: `import type { MetadataExtraction } from '@specd/sdk'`

## Signature

`interface MetadataExtraction`

## Fields

| Field         | Type                                | Required | Description                                                       |
| ------------- | ----------------------------------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `constraints` | `readonly MetadataExtractorEntry[]` | no       | Extracts constraint strings.                                      |
| `context`     | `readonly MetadataExtractorEntry[]` | no       | Extracts always-included context content.                         |
| `dependsOn`   | `MetadataExtractorEntry`            | no       | Extracts dependency spec paths from link references.              |
| `description` | `MetadataExtractorEntry`            | no       | Extracts the spec description (Overview/Purpose section content). |
| `keywords`    | `MetadataExtractorEntry`            | no       | Extracts keyword terms.                                           |
| `rules`       | `readonly MetadataExtractorEntry[]` | no       | Extracts structured rule groups.                                  |
| `scenarios`   | `readonly MetadataExtractorEntry[]` | no       | Extracts structured scenario objects.                             |
| `title`       | `MetadataExtractorEntry`            | no       | Extracts the spec title (first H1 heading).                       |

## Related types

| Type                     | Topic                                    |
| ------------------------ | ---------------------------------------- |
| `MetadataExtractorEntry` | `core:interfaces/MetadataExtractorEntry` |

# OpenSpecdHostInput

Input for openSpecdHost.

Callers may bootstrap from one explicit config file via `configPath`, from one
discovery root via `startDir`, or from `process.cwd()` by omitting both fields.
`configPath` and `startDir` must never be provided together.

Import: `import type { OpenSpecdHostInput } from '@specd/sdk'`

## Signature

`interface OpenSpecdHostInput`

## Fields

| Field                    | Type                | Required | Description                                                                |
| ------------------------ | ------------------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `allowBootstrapFallback` | `boolean`           | no       | Permit discovery-mode graph bootstrap when no configuration exists.        |
| `configPath`             | `string`            | no       | Absolute path to `specd.yaml` for forced load mode.                        |
| `options`                | `SdkContextOptions` | no       | Optional SDK-owned kernel and graph composition overrides.                 |
| `startDir`               | `string`            | no       | Directory to start config discovery from without mutating `process.cwd()`. |

| `createGraphProvider` | `() => CodeGraphProvider` | Creates a new CodeGraphProvider for the host config.                       |
| `kernel`              | `Kernel`                  | Wired specd kernel for lifecycle and project queries.                      |

catalog.description: Applies a change's delta artifacts to the base spec content and returns the merged result per artifact file, without mutating anything. Consumed by `CompileContext` (for materialized views) and by the CLI `change spec-preview` command (for human review).
catalog.content:
# PreviewSpec

Applies a change's delta artifacts to the base spec content and returns
the merged result per artifact file, without mutating anything.

Consumed by `CompileContext` (for materialized views) and by the CLI
`change spec-preview` command (for human review).

Import: `import type { PreviewSpec } from '@specd/sdk'`

## Signature

`interface PreviewSpec`

## Methods

### execute

Previews a spec by applying delta artifacts from a change.

`execute(input: PreviewSpecInput): Promise<PreviewSpecResult>`

| Parameter | Type               | Description        |
| --------- | ------------------ | ------------------ |
| `input`   | `PreviewSpecInput` | Preview parameters |

**Returns** `Promise<PreviewSpecResult>` — The preview result with per-file entries and warnings

## Related types

| Type                | Topic                               |
| ------------------- | ----------------------------------- |
| `PreviewSpecInput`  | `core:interfaces/PreviewSpecInput`  |
| `PreviewSpecResult` | `core:interfaces/PreviewSpecResult` |

catalog.description: A single artifact file in the preview result.
catalog.content:
# PreviewSpecFileEntry

A single artifact file in the preview result.

Import: `import type { PreviewSpecFileEntry } from '@specd/sdk'`

## Signature

`interface PreviewSpecFileEntry`

## Fields

| Field      | Type                               | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| ---------- | ---------------------------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `base`     | `string \| null`                   | yes      | The original base content (before delta application). `null` for new specs.                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `diff`     | `string`                           | no       | Optional unified diff generated from `base` and `merged`.                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `filename` | `string`                           | yes      | The artifact filename (e.g. `spec.md`, `verify.md`).                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `merged`   | `string`                           | yes      | The merged content (after delta application).                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `status`   | `"missing" \| "merged" \| "no-op"` | yes      | The preview status of this file. - 'merged': delta applied successfully with changes, or new spec file - 'no-op': delta applied but resulted in no changes to base content - 'missing': delta file or base artifact not found, or delta application failed |

catalog.content:
# ResolveContextSpecsResult

Spec IDs partitioned by the configuration layer that included them.

**Dual listing is required:** when project-level patterns and a workspace's
patterns both include the same ID (and it survives excludes), that ID MUST
appear under `project` **and** under the corresponding `workspaces[name]`
entry. Callers rely on this to distinguish project vs workspace provenance.

Import: `import type { ResolveContextSpecsResult } from '@specd/sdk'`

## Signature

`interface ResolveContextSpecsResult`

## Fields

| Field        | Type                                          | Description                                                                 |
| ------------ | --------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `project`    | `readonly string[]`                           | Specs included by project-level patterns that remain after all excludes.    |
| `workspaces` | `Readonly<Record<string, readonly string[]>>` | Specs included by each workspace's patterns that remain after all excludes. |

catalog.title: SchemaRegistry
catalog.description: Port for routing schema references and resolving schemas. Resolution is prefix-driven — no implicit multi-level fallback: - `@scope/name` — npm package; loaded from `node_modules/@scope/name/schema.yaml` - `#workspace:name` — workspace-qualified; delegated to `SchemaRepository` for that workspace - `#name` or bare name — equivalent to `#default:name`; delegated to the `default` workspace's `SchemaRepository` - relative or absolute path — loaded directly from that path Implementations receive a `ReadonlyMap<string, SchemaRepository>` at construction time, mapping workspace names to their corresponding `SchemaRepository` instances.
catalog.content:
# SchemaRegistry

Port for routing schema references and resolving schemas.

Resolution is prefix-driven — no implicit multi-level fallback:

- `@scope/name` — npm package; loaded from `node_modules/@scope/name/schema.yaml`
- `#workspace:name` — workspace-qualified; delegated to `SchemaRepository` for that workspace
- `#name` or bare name — equivalent to `#default:name`; delegated to the `default` workspace's `SchemaRepository`
- relative or absolute path — loaded directly from that path

Implementations receive a `ReadonlyMap<string, SchemaRepository>` at construction
time, mapping workspace names to their corresponding `SchemaRepository` instances.

Import: `import type { SchemaRegistry } from '@specd/sdk'`

## Signature

`interface SchemaRegistry`

## Methods

### list

Lists all schemas discoverable from workspace repositories and installed
npm packages. Does not load or validate schema file contents — use
`resolve()` to get a fully-parsed Schema.

Results are grouped by source: workspace entries first (in workspace
declaration order), npm entries last.

`list(): Promise<SchemaEntry[]>`

**Returns** `Promise<SchemaEntry[]>` — All discoverable schema entries

### resolve

Resolves a schema reference and returns the fully-parsed Schema.

The `ref` value is the `schema` field from `specd.yaml` verbatim.
Returns `null` if the resolved file does not exist; the caller is
responsible for converting a `null` result to `SchemaNotFoundError`.

Workspace schema resolution is delegated to the corresponding
`SchemaRepository` instance.

`resolve(ref: string): Promise<Schema | null>`

| Parameter | Type     | Description                                                                                                                                      |
| --------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `ref`     | `string` | The schema reference as declared in `specd.yaml` (e.g. `"@specd/schema-std"`, `"#billing:my-schema"`, `"spec-driven"`, `"./custom/schema.yaml"`) |

**Returns** `Promise<Schema \| null>` — The resolved schema, or `null` if the file was not found

### resolveRaw

Resolves a schema reference and returns the intermediate representation
(parsed YAML data, templates, and resolved path) without building the
final domain `Schema`.

Used by `ResolveSchema` for the merge pipeline where raw data is needed.
Workspace schema resolution is delegated to the corresponding
`SchemaRepository` instance.

`resolveRaw(ref: string): Promise<SchemaRawResult | null>`

| Parameter | Type     | Description                                      |
| --------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| `ref`     | `string` | The schema reference as declared in `specd.yaml` |

**Returns** `Promise<SchemaRawResult \| null>` — The raw resolution result, or `null` if the file was not found

## Related types

| Type              | Topic                             |
| ----------------- | --------------------------------- |
| `Schema`          | `core:classes/Schema`             |
| `SchemaRawResult` | `core:interfaces/SchemaRawResult` |

catalog.description: Identifies one or more nodes in an artifact's AST. catalog.content:
# Selector

Identifies one or more nodes in an artifact's AST.

Used in delta entries (to target nodes for modification or removal), in
`metadataExtraction` (to extract spec content), and in validation rules
(to assert structural constraints).

All string fields (`matches`, `contains`, `where` values) are matched
case-insensitively as regular expressions.

Import: `import type { Selector } from '@specd/sdk'`

## Signature

`interface Selector`

## Fields

| Field      | Type                               | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                              |
| ---------- | ---------------------------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `contains` | `string`                           | no       | Regex matched case-insensitively against the node's `value`.                                                                                                                             |
| `index`    | `number`                           | no       | Targets the item at this zero-based index within an `array-item` or `sequence-item` list. Mutually exclusive with `where`.                                                               |
| `level`    | `number`                           | no       | For markdown `section` nodes, matches only sections at this heading level (1 = `#`, 2 = `##`, etc.). Non-markdown nodes without `level` will not match.                                  |
| `matches`  | `string`                           | no       | Regex matched case-insensitively against the node's `label`.                                                                                                                             |
| `parent`   | `Selector`                         | no       | Constrains the search to nodes whose nearest ancestor matches this selector.                                                                                                             |
| `type`     | `string`                           | yes      | Node type; must be one of the values returned by `ArtifactParser.nodeTypes()`.                                                                                                           |
| `where`    | `Readonly<Record<string, string>>` | no       | For `array-item` / `sequence-item` nodes that are objects, targets the item whose fields match all key–value pairs (values are case-insensitive regex). Mutually exclusive with `index`. |

catalog.content:
# SpecdConfig

Fully-resolved project configuration derived from `specd.yaml`.

All paths are absolute. `isExternal` is inferred — not declared in the YAML.
Delivery mechanisms (`@specd/cli`, `@specd/mcp`) receive a `SpecdConfig`
from `ConfigLoader` and pass it to `createKernel()` or individual
use-case factory functions.

Import: `import type { SpecdConfig } from '@specd/sdk'`

## Signature

`interface SpecdConfig`

## Fields

| Field                 | Type                                                                                   | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| --------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `actorProvider`       | `string`                                                                               | no       | Forced actor provider name. When set, bypasses auto-detection.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `approvals`           | `{ signoff: boolean; spec: boolean }`                                                  | yes      | Approval gate settings (both default to `false`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `configPath`          | `string`                                                                               | yes      | Absolute path to the specd-owned config root.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `context`             | `readonly SpecdContextEntry[]`                                                         | no       | Freeform context entries prepended to the compiled context.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `contextExcludeSpecs` | `readonly string[]`                                                                    | no       | Project-level context spec exclude patterns. Always applied regardless of active workspace.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `contextIncludeSpecs` | `readonly string[]`                                                                    | no       | Project-level context spec include patterns. Always applied regardless of active workspace. When omitted, no project-level include patterns are applied.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `contextMode`         | `SpecdContextMode`                                                                     | no       | Controls how `CompileContext` renders specs in the compiled context. - `'list'` — render only spec IDs with source/mode metadata. - `'summary'` (default) — render spec catalogue entries (title + description). - `'full'` — render all collected specs with full content. - `'hybrid'` — render direct change specs in full when included, all others as summary. Project-level only — not valid inside workspace entries. |
| `graph`               | `SpecdGraphConfig`                                                                     | no       | Project-level code graph configuration.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `invalidationPolicy`  | `InvalidationPolicy`                                                                   | no       | Default invalidation policy for new changes. Defaults to `'downstream'`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `llmOptimizedContext` | `boolean`                                                                              | no       | When `true`, specd may invoke an LLM for enriched output (default: `false`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `logging`             | `SpecdLoggingConfig`                                                                   | no       | Project-level logging configuration.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `plugins`             | `{ agents?: readonly { config?: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>; name: string }[] }` | no       | Declared plugins grouped by type (currently `agents`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `privacy`             | `PrivacyConfig`                                                                        | no       | Identity privacy configuration.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `projectRoot`         | `string`                                                                               | yes      | Absolute path to the directory containing the active `specd.yaml`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `schemaOverrides`     | `SchemaOperations`                                                                     | no       | Inline schema override operations from `specd.yaml`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `schemaPlugins`       | `readonly string[]`                                                                    | no       | Schema plugin references from `specd.yaml`, in declaration order.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `schemaRef`           | `string`                                                                               | yes      | Schema reference string as declared in `specd.yaml` (e.g. `'@specd/schema-std'`).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `specdPath`           | `string`                                                                               | no       | Absolute path to the specd workspace folder.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `storage`             | `SpecdStorageConfig`                                                                   | yes      | Resolved storage paths.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `warnings`            | `readonly string[]`                                                                    | no       | Non-fatal diagnostics generated during configuration loading, for example legacy configuration format warnings. Hosts consume and report these from the resolved config object.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `workspaces`          | `readonly SpecdWorkspaceConfig[]`                                                      | yes      | All configured workspaces. Must contain exactly one `name === 'default'` entry.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |

catalog.content:
# SpecRepository

Port for reading and writing specs within a single workspace.

Extends Repository — `workspace()`, `ownership()`, and `isExternal()` are
set at construction time and cannot change. Use cases that need multiple workspaces
receive a separate instance per workspace.

`list` and `get` return lightweight Spec metadata — no artifact content
is loaded. Content is fetched explicitly via `artifact()`. Write operations
receive a `Spec` so implementations never deal with raw paths.

`search` performs content-based search across all spec artifacts in this workspace,
returning results ranked by relevance score.

Import: `import type { SpecRepository } from '@specd/sdk'`

## Signature

`interface SpecRepository extends Repository`

## Fields

| Field       | Type                  | Description                                                                                                                      |
| ----------- | --------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `specsPath` | `string \| undefined` | Returns the canonical specs root path for filesystem-backed repositories. Non-filesystem-backed repositories return `undefined`. |

## Methods

### artifact

Loads the content of a single artifact file within a spec.

`artifact(spec: Spec, filename: string): Promise<SpecArtifact | null>`

| Parameter  | Type     | Description                                      |
| ---------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| `spec`     | `Spec`   | The spec containing the artifact                 |
| `filename` | `string` | The artifact filename to load (e.g. `"spec.md"`) |

**Returns** `Promise<SpecArtifact \| null>` — The artifact with its content, or `null` if the file does not exist

### artifactMeta

Returns physical artifact metadata for one filename, or `null` when absent.

`hash` is included only when `options.includeHash === true`.

`artifactMeta(spec: Spec, filename: string, options?: SpecMetaOptions): Promise<ArtifactMeta | null>`

| Parameter  | Type              | Required |
| ---------- | ----------------- | -------- |
| `spec`     | `Spec`            | yes      |
| `filename` | `string`          | yes      |
| `options`  | `SpecMetaOptions` | no       |

**Returns** `Promise<ArtifactMeta \| null>`

### configPath

Returns the absolute path to the config directory.

`configPath(): string`

**Returns** `string` — The config path (e.g. `/project/.specd/config`)

### count

Returns the total number of specs in this workspace.

This provides an efficient way to discover workspace size without loading
all lightweight metadata into memory.

`count(): Promise<number>`

**Returns** `Promise<number>` — The total spec count (same source as `list().meta.total`)

### delete

Deletes the entire spec directory and all its artifact files.

`delete(spec: Spec): Promise<void>`

| Parameter | Type   | Description        |
| --------- | ------ | ------------------ |
| `spec`    | `Spec` | The spec to delete |

**Returns** `Promise<void>`

### generatedMetadataMeta

Cheap observation of the generated metadata cache file.

Same lastModified / optional hash rules as persistedStateMeta.

`generatedMetadataMeta(spec: Spec, options?: SpecMetaOptions): Promise<GeneratedMetadataMeta | null>`

| Parameter | Type              | Required |
| --------- | ----------------- | -------- |
| `spec`    | `Spec`            | yes      |
| `options` | `SpecMetaOptions` | no       |

**Returns** `Promise<GeneratedMetadataMeta \| null>`

### get

Returns the spec metadata for the given name, or `null` if not found.

`get(name: SpecPath): Promise<Spec | null>`

| Parameter | Type       | Description                                                      |
| --------- | ---------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `name`    | `SpecPath` | The spec identity path within this workspace (e.g. `auth/oauth`) |

**Returns** `Promise<Spec \| null>` — The spec metadata, or `null` if no such spec exists

### invalidateCache

Resets whatever this adapter caches.

Default is a no-op. Filesystem adapters override to invalidate list-index
helpers. Callers that know the on-disk tree changed outside the repository
MAY invoke this without knowing adapter-specific cache details.

`invalidateCache(): Promise<void>`

**Returns** `Promise<void>`

### isExternal

Returns whether this repository points to data outside the current git repository.

`isExternal(): boolean`

**Returns** `boolean` — `true` if this repository is external to the current git root

### list

Lists specs in this workspace, optionally filtered by a path prefix.

Returns lightweight SpecListEntry rows — no artifact content is loaded
unless include flags request projected fields already materialized in the index.

`list(prefix?: SpecPath, options?: SpecListOptions): Promise<ListResult<SpecListEntry>>`

| Parameter | Type              | Required | Description                                                               |
| --------- | ----------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `prefix`  | `SpecPath`        | no       | Optional path prefix to filter results (e.g. `auth` returns all `auth/*`) |
| `options` | `SpecListOptions` | no       | Pagination and include projection options                                 |

**Returns** `Promise<ListResult<SpecListEntry>>` — Paginated matching specs in canonical path order

### ownership

Returns the ownership level of this repository, as declared in `specd.yaml`.

`ownership(): "owned" | "shared" | "readOnly"`

**Returns** `"owned" \| "shared" \| "readOnly"` — The ownership level

### persistedStateMeta

Cheap observation of the persisted semantic state sidecar.

`null` when absent. `hash` only when `options.includeHash === true`.

`persistedStateMeta(spec: Spec, options?: SpecMetaOptions): Promise<PersistedStateMeta | null>`

| Parameter | Type              | Required |
| --------- | ----------------- | -------- |
| `spec`    | `Spec`            | yes      |
| `options` | `SpecMetaOptions` | no       |

**Returns** `Promise<PersistedStateMeta \| null>`

### publish

Publishes the canonical artifact set for one spec as a single storage commit.

Implementations SHOULD guarantee that a failed publication does not leave
partially-updated canonical artifact files visible for that spec.

`publish(spec: Spec, publication: SpecPublication): Promise<void>`

| Parameter     | Type              | Description                                            |
| ------------- | ----------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| `spec`        | `Spec`            | The spec whose canonical artifacts are being published |
| `publication` | `SpecPublication` | Final artifact bundle to publish                       |

**Returns** `Promise<void>` — When publication completes successfully

### readMetadataSnapshot

Reads the exact persisted metadata observation.

`readMetadataSnapshot(spec: Spec): Promise<MetadataSnapshot>`

| Parameter | Type   |
| --------- | ------ |
| `spec`    | `Spec` |

**Returns** `Promise<MetadataSnapshot>`

### readPersistedState

Reads the exact persisted semantic state, or `null` when no lock exists.

`readPersistedState(spec: Spec): Promise<PersistedSpecStateSnapshot | null>`

| Parameter | Type   |
| --------- | ------ |
| `spec`    | `Spec` |

**Returns** `Promise<PersistedSpecStateSnapshot \| null>`

### reindex

Rebuilds the spec list fs-cache index for this workspace.

`reindex(): Promise<void>`

**Returns** `Promise<void>`

### resolveFromPath

Resolves a storage path to a spec identity within this workspace.

Accepts both absolute paths and relative spec links. When `inputPath`
is relative (e.g. `../storage/spec.md`), `from` must be provided as
the reference spec. Relative resolution is pure computation (no I/O);
absolute resolution may require filesystem access.

Returns one of:

- `{ specPath, specId }` — resolved within this workspace
- `{ crossWorkspaceHint }` — relative path escaped this workspace;
  the caller should try other repositories with the hint segments
- `null` — not a valid spec link

`resolveFromPath(inputPath: string, from?: SpecPath): Promise<ResolveFromPathResult | null>`

| Parameter   | Type       | Required | Description                                                                    |
| ----------- | ---------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `inputPath` | `string`   | yes      | Absolute path or relative spec link (e.g. `../storage/spec.md`)                |
| `from`      | `SpecPath` | no       | Reference spec for relative resolution (required when `inputPath` is relative) |

**Returns** `Promise<ResolveFromPathResult \| null>` — The resolved result, a cross-workspace hint, or `null`

### save

Persists a single artifact file within a spec.

Creates the spec directory if it does not exist.

If `artifact.originalHash` is set and does not match the current file on
disk, the save is rejected with `ArtifactConflictError` to prevent
silently overwriting concurrent changes. Pass `{ force: true }` to
overwrite regardless.

`save(spec: Spec, artifact: SpecArtifact, options?: { force?: boolean }): Promise<void>`

| Parameter  | Type                  | Required | Description                               |
| ---------- | --------------------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| `spec`     | `Spec`                | yes      | The spec to write the artifact into       |
| `artifact` | `SpecArtifact`        | yes      | The artifact to save (filename + content) |
| `options`  | `{ force?: boolean }` | no       | Save options                              |

**Returns** `Promise<void>`

### search

Searches spec artifact content for the given query string.

Performs case-insensitive substring matching across all spec artifacts.
Results are returned sorted by descending relevance score.

`search(query: string, options?: { limit?: number }): Promise<SpecSearchResult[]>`

| Parameter | Type                 | Required | Description             |
| --------- | -------------------- | -------- | ----------------------- |
| `query`   | `string`             | yes      | The search query string |
| `options` | `{ limit?: number }` | no       | Search options          |

**Returns** `Promise<SpecSearchResult[]>` — Matching specs with scores and match locations, sorted by relevance

### specFingerprint

Returns a content fingerprint for authored artifacts and persisted state.

Generated metadata MUST NOT be included.

`specFingerprint(spec: Spec): Promise<string>`

| Parameter | Type   | Description                           |
| --------- | ------ | ------------------------------------- |
| `spec`    | `Spec` | The spec whose fingerprint to compute |

**Returns** `Promise<string>`

### workspace

Returns the workspace name this repository is bound to.

`workspace(): string`

**Returns** `string` — The workspace name (e.g. `"billing"`, `"default"`)

### writeMetadataSnapshot

Writes one complete metadata projection.

`expectedRevision: null` means metadata must still be absent.
Read-only workspaces still permit metadata cache writes.

`writeMetadataSnapshot(spec: Spec, metadata: SpecMetadata, options: { expectedRevision: string | null }): Promise<MetadataSnapshot>`

| Parameter  | Type                                   |
| ---------- | -------------------------------------- |
| `spec`     | `Spec`                                 |
| `metadata` | `SpecMetadata`                         |
| `options`  | `{ expectedRevision: string \| null }` |

**Returns** `Promise<MetadataSnapshot>`

### writePersistedState

Conditionally replaces the complete persisted state.

`expectedRevision: null` means the caller observed persisted state as absent
and intends to create it — the write MUST fail if state already exists.

`writePersistedState(spec: Spec, state: PersistedSpecState, options: { expectedRevision: string | null }): Promise<PersistedSpecStateSnapshot>`

| Parameter | Type                                   |
| --------- | -------------------------------------- |
| `spec`    | `Spec`                                 |
| `state`   | `PersistedSpecState`                   |
| `options` | `{ expectedRevision: string \| null }` |

**Returns** `Promise<PersistedSpecStateSnapshot>`

## Related types

| Type            | Topic                           |
| --------------- | ------------------------------- |
| `ListResult`    | `core:interfaces/ListResult`    |
| `Spec`          | `core:classes/Spec`             |
| `SpecArtifact`  | `core:classes/SpecArtifact`     |
| `SpecListEntry` | `core:interfaces/SpecListEntry` |
| `SpecMetadata`  | `core:interfaces/SpecMetadata`  |
| `SpecPath`      | `core:classes/SpecPath`         |

catalog.title: TransitionChange
catalog.description: Performs a lifecycle state transition on a change with approval-gate routing, workflow requires enforcement, task completion gating, and hook execution. Handles the two smart-routing decision points: - `ready → implementing` is redirected to `ready → pending-spec-approval` when the spec approval gate is active. - `done → archivable` is redirected to `done → pending-signoff` when the signoff gate is active. When the target step declares `requiresTaskCompletion`, each listed artifact is content-checked for incomplete items. This is controlled per-step, not globally for all artifacts with `taskCompletionCheck`. Enforces workflow `requires` for the target step and executes `run:` hooks at step boundaries (unless skipped via `skipHookPhases`).
catalog.content:
# TransitionChange

Performs a lifecycle state transition on a change with approval-gate routing,
workflow requires enforcement, task completion gating, and hook execution.

Handles the two smart-routing decision points:

- `ready → implementing` is redirected to `ready → pending-spec-approval`
  when the spec approval gate is active.
- `done → archivable` is redirected to `done → pending-signoff` when the
  signoff gate is active.

When the target step declares `requiresTaskCompletion`, each listed artifact
is content-checked for incomplete items. This is controlled per-step, not
globally for all artifacts with `taskCompletionCheck`.

Enforces workflow `requires` for the target step and executes `run:` hooks
at step boundaries (unless skipped via `skipHookPhases`).

Input for the TransitionChange use case.

| Field                                 | Type                             | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |

| `name`                                | `string`                         | yes      | The change to transition.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `refreshImplementationTrackingBefore` | `boolean`                        | no       | When omitted or `true`, refresh tracked implementation files before transition for active changes only. When `false`, skip refresh.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `skipHookPhases`                      | `ReadonlySet<HookPhaseSelector>` | no       | Which hook phases to skip during the transition. Valid selectors: `'source.pre'`, `'source.post'`, `'target.pre'`, `'target.post'`, `'all'`. When `'all'` is in the set, all hooks are skipped. When empty (default), all applicable hooks execute. The caller is responsible for invoking skipped hooks separately via `RunStepHooks`.                                       |
| `to`                                  | `ChangeState`                    | yes      | The requested target state. Smart routing applies at two decision points when gates are active at construction: - `'implementing'` requested from `ready`: routes to `pending-spec-approval` when the spec gate is enabled. - `'archivable'` requested from `done`: routes to `pending-signoff` when the signoff gate is enabled. All other states are transitioned directly. |

catalog.description: Validates a change's artifact files against the active schema and marks them complete. The only path through which an artifact may reach `complete` status. # ValidateArtifacts

Validates a change's artifact files against the active schema and marks them
complete. The only path through which an artifact may reach `complete` status.

Enforces required artifacts, validates structural rules, detects delta
conflicts, and invalidates any outstanding approval when artifact content has
changed since the approval was recorded.

# WorkflowStep

A single entry in a schema's `workflow[]` array, defining a named lifecycle
phase, which artifact IDs must be complete before the phase becomes available,
and optional pre/post hook arrays.

Schema workflow steps fire first; project-level steps (`specd.yaml`) are

| `requires`               | `readonly string[]`                                         | Artifact IDs (from the same schema) that must have status `complete` before this step becomes available. Empty array means the step is always available.                                                                                       |
| `requiresTaskCompletion` | `readonly string[]`                                         | Subset of `requires` for which task completion gating is enforced on this step. Each listed artifact ID must be in `requires` and reference an artifact type that declares `taskCompletionCheck`. Empty array means no task completion gating. |

catalog.content:
# applyPreHashCleanup

Applies pre-hash cleanup substitutions to artifact content.

Pre-hash cleanup rules are regex-based substitutions defined in the schema.
They strip variable content (timestamps, whitespace, etc.) from artifact
content before computing a hash, ensuring that formatting changes that
don't affect substance don't invalidate the hash.

Import: `import { applyPreHashCleanup } from '@specd/sdk'`

## Signature

`function applyPreHashCleanup(content: string, cleanups: readonly PreHashCleanup[]): string`

| Parameter  | Type                        | Description                            |
| ---------- | --------------------------- | -------------------------------------- |
| `content`  | `string`                    | The raw artifact content               |
| `cleanups` | `readonly PreHashCleanup[]` | Pre-hash cleanup rules from the schema |

**Returns** `string` — The cleaned content with all substitutions applied

## Usage

```typescript
import { applyPreHashCleanup } from '@specd/sdk'

const result = applyPreHashCleanup(content, cleanups)
```

| Type             | Topic                            |
| ---------------- | -------------------------------- |
| `PreHashCleanup` | `core:interfaces/PreHashCleanup` |

```typescript
import { extractSpecSummary } from '@specd/sdk'

const result = extractSpecSummary(content)
```

catalog.title: Skills Template Rendering
catalog.description: How `@specd/skills` renders install-time skill templates for agent plugins.
catalog.content:
# Skills Template Rendering

`@specd/skills` renders install-time skill templates for agent plugins from
`packages/skills/templates/`.

## Source files

- Skill-local and shared template source files use the `.md.tpl` extension.
- Resolved install output files use the same name without the trailing `.tpl`.
- Skill-local templates live in `packages/skills/templates/<skill-name>/`.
- Shared templates live in `packages/skills/templates/shared/`.
- Each skill-local directory also contains `skill.meta.json`.

## Skill metadata

Each skill directory declares its template contract in `skill.meta.json`:

```json
{
  "supportedCapabilities": ["mcp", "agents", "frontmatter"],
  "requiredCapabilities": [],
  "requiredSharedTemplates": ["shared.md"]
}
```

- `supportedCapabilities` declares which capability identifiers templates in that folder may reference.
- `requiredCapabilities` declares which capability identifiers must be present for the skill to be installable.
- `requiredSharedTemplates` declares which files from `templates/shared/` are included in the resolved bundle.

## Render context

Templates receive:

- `variables` as a recursive object tree
- `capabilities` from plugins as a list of identifiers such as `['mcp', 'agents', 'frontmatter']`
- `frontmatter` as the final YAML block to inject when enabled

`@specd/skills` normalizes the capability list internally for template rendering.

Built-in public variables are privacy-safe:

- `configPath`
- `schemaRef`
- `sharedFolder`

`projectRoot` is used only internally for validation and is not exposed to templates.

The initial required capability identifiers are:

- `mcp`
- `agents`
- `frontmatter`

## Supported template features

Templates may use `Handlebars` features that keep rendering declarative:

- `{{variable}}`
- `{{variables.frontmatter.name}}`
- `{{#if capabilities.mcp}} ... {{else}} ... {{/if}}`
- `{{#each someList}} ... {{/each}}`

Templates must not rely on arbitrary runtime code execution.

## Frontmatter insertion

Skill-local templates may declare a frontmatter insertion point with:

```md
{{{frontmatter}}}
```

`@specd/skills` composes that YAML block from `variables.frontmatter`.
The block is emitted only when:

- `capabilities.frontmatter` is enabled
- `variables.frontmatter` is present
- the target file is not marked as shared

Shared templates must remain free of runtime frontmatter blocks.

## Shared templates

Shared references inside markdown use:

```md
@{{sharedFolder}}/shared.md
```

`sharedFolder` is treated as a regular template variable:

- it remains relative to the project root in rendered output
- `@specd/skills` injects a default when the plugin does not provide one
- `@specd/skills` normalizes away any trailing `/`
- `@specd/skills` rejects values that escape the project root

## Authoring guidance

- Keep existing workflow wording intact when migrating a template to `.md.tpl`.
- Use capability branches only where the runtime behavior genuinely differs.
- Prefer `capabilities.*` for control flow and `variables.*` for render data.
- Keep frontmatter values structured in plugin code; do not pass prebuilt YAML from plugins.
